This FloPlast 135° double socket top offset bend is a crucial component for effective soil and vent drainage systems. Manufactured from durable uPVC, it provides strength and a lightweight solution for demanding plumbing installations. The push-fit system, coupled with options for ring seal or solvent weld joints, ensures quick and reliable connections, making it ideal for professional plumbers and installers requiring efficient wastewater management. Its design is suitable for high temperature waste discharges and facilitates seamless integration into existing 110mm pipework, especially in confined spaces where precise angled connections are essential. The use of silicone lubricant on all seals will facilitate jointing.
